mapper.select: SELECT T1.ENTRUST_ID TRADE_ID, T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID TOTLE_TRADE_ID , T1.FINPROD_ID, T1.UPDATE_USER launchUser FROM REG_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL T1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT MIN(EXERCISE_DATE) EXERCISE_DATE, FINPROD_ID FROM FIN_EXERCISE_PLAN GROUP BY FINPROD_ID) T2 ON T2.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN ETR_ENTRUST T4 ON T4.ENTRUST_ID = T1.ENTRUST_ID WHERE T1.PS = 'T03' AND T1.TRADE_STATUS = '01' AND T1.IS_CANCEL = 'Y' AND T4.ENTRUST_ID IN ('02', '03', '09') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM REG_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL T3 WHERE T3.ENTRUST_ID = T1.ENTRUST_ID AND T3.PS = 'T03' AND T3.TRADE_STATUS = '01' AND (T3.IS_CANCEL = 'N' OR T3.IS_CANCEL IS NULL) AND T1.TRADE_DATE = #{checkDate,jdbcType=DATE} AND T3.TRADE_DATE = T2.EXERCISE_DATE - 1)
